title: Bayer interpolation reads outside images narrower than two pixels
summary: Public Bayer helpers have no documented minimum dimension or guard. For RGGB 1x1, interpolation reads raw[1] and raw[2]. A padded demonstration through an existing unrebuilt dylib changes output from [10,0,0] to [10,77,77] and [10,200,200] solely by changing bytes after the one logical pixel. Current source confirms those reads; library provenance is not attested. Define narrow-image handling in ordinary/stretched paths and test 1x1,1xN,Nx1. Driver-specific remote reachability is unestablished; solver preview uses no Bayer pattern.
